Dataset.Description: 4 synthetic test PDFs created by cycling over 4 source documents; local filesystem. Actual PDF-text/OCR paths and engine image counts are recorded in Provenance. Not distinct production scans.

Samples.ExpectedName: ВКЕМ.461411.200 Плата Epcos USB 1489 МГц Спецификация.pdf

RuntimeDescription.BasePair: Tesseract rus+eng and eastern-Slavic PaddleOCR; PDF text requires independent raster confirmation.
RuntimeDescription.OptionalGostPair: Lazy Tesseract rus_gost+eng and Cyrillic PaddleOCR; actual attempts/acceptances are counted in Provenance.
RuntimeDescription.RouteCache: Only the model choice for a template is cached; every new PDF is read again. Text, field values and rename answers are not cached.

Configuration.Warmup: One untimed read of each unique document, then optional phase profiles; new real OCR engines are still initialized inside the timed full run.

Measurement.ResourceScope: Parent plus registered OCR child processes; working sets and threads sampled together every100ms; shared file-backed pages are counted per process, not unique physical RAM. Final child CPU uses OS/report values, or the last available sample after an exit race.
Measurement.ProjectionWarning: Linear extrapolation from repeated synthetic single-page files; not a measured 8000-document run.

PhaseProfile.Scope: Sequential warmed production DocumentReader reads, with each actual PDF-text/OCR path recorded in Trace. Timing callbacks are enabled only for these profiles, not full throughput.

Provenance.Scope: Only actual timed results, including skipped documents; source/status groups separate acceptance from attempts. PDF-text is confirmed by a raster peer, not claimed as dual OCR.
Provenance.CounterDefinitions: PDF-text and GOST attempts/acceptances count matched-page route attempts/successes; engine reads count field images submitted, including fallback. A Paddle batch of three fields counts three reads. MatchingCalls counts page-level matcher calls. Model choices may be cached per template; text/recognition results are not cached.
